description: §7.6 rule (b) (S479): the call chain reads only a binding initialized before `A` — clean; the initializer runs once at module initialization (12).
rationale: §7.6 rule (b) (S479): "An initializer that reaches a file-scope binding declared after it — directly, or through a function it calls, at any depth — SHALL be **`E-SCOPE-001`**, the same error as reading the later binding directly". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — #1962 file-scope questions 1–4 + `parseVariant` duplicate keys, PA recs adopted" item 2. Rule (b): "Any other non-constant initializer is evaluated at module initialization, once".
